annotation.title_clean: ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025 Artificial intelligence — Data quality for analytics and machine learning (ML) — Part 5: Data quality governance framework
annotation.title_en: ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025 Artificial intelligence — Data quality for analytics and machine learning (ML) — Part 5: Data quality governance framework
annotation.summary_en: ISO store page for ISO/IEC 5259-5:2025, a published international standard giving a data quality governance framework for analytics and machine learning. It helps governing bodies and senior management direct and oversee data quality across the data life cycle, with clear responsibilities. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Provides a governance-level framework for data quality in analytics and ML, defining the 'why' and 'who' rather than the 'how'.
Targets governing bodies and senior management responsible for data quality policy.
Embeds accountability and quality controls across the whole data life cycle.
Complements ISO/IEC 5259-3 and 5259-4 on management and operational processes.
